top_stories.title: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released security updates addressing CVE-2026-88779, a high-severity memory overflow vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway with a CVSS score of 8.7, which is being actively exploited in targeted zero-day attacks. The flaw can knock SAML deployments offline, directly impacting identity federation and authentication infrastructure used in IAM environments.

top_stories.title: Four Providers, 15 CVEs, Three Days — The Agent Identity Stack Is Under Coordinated Attack
top_stories.summary: Between October 2–5, 2026, four identity-layer providers were hit with 15 CVEs in three days, including a 10-CVE cluster in ZITADEL, a Zimbra authentication vulnerability, a Bouncy Castle cryptographic flaw, and an MCP OAuth credential theft issue. The coordinated timing of these disclosures targeted core components of the agent identity stack, affecting authentication, authorization, and cryptographic libraries used across IAM implementations.

top_stories.title: MFA Passed. The Attacker Still Got In.
top_stories.summary: The article examines how MFA can be bypassed by attackers and advocates for the transition from MFA to passkeys within Microsoft Entra ID. It is part one of a seven-part series addressing authentication security gaps and the move toward phishing-resistant credentials.

top_stories.title: Okta XAA Ecosystem Scales to 25+ Partners as AI Gateways Become the Identity Enforcement Layer
top_stories.summary: Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) protocol ecosystem has scaled to 25+ partners, with AI gateway vendor TrueFoundry announcing integration on October 1. The XAA protocol positions AI gateways as identity enforcement layers where agents present credentials before accessing downstream resources.

top_stories.title: Danish university DTU breach exposes data of up to 200,000 people
top_stories.summary: The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) suffered a breach in which hackers accessed its identity and access management system and downloaded data belonging to up to 200,000 users. The attack directly targeted the IAM infrastructure, exposing personal information of students, staff, and potentially other individuals associated with the university.

news.title: AI Agent Gateway: Open-source tool keeps credentials out of agent configs
news.summary: Tuskira released an open-source AI Agent Gateway that centralizes credential management for AI agents, preventing model keys and MCP credentials from being embedded in individual agent configurations. The gateway sits between AI agents and their called services (MCP tool servers, model providers), running in the user's own environment without requiring a Tuskira account.

news.title: Fake ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude Ad Portals Capture Credentials and MFA Codes
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have identified a human-operated phishing platform that impersonates advertising portals for AI chatbots including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to harvest credentials and MFA codes. The platform lures victims with fake campaign optimization and business-account connection services, targeting multi-factor authentication bypass as part of its credential theft operation.

news.title: Fake ChatGPT, Gemini Sites steal advertising accounts, MFA codes
news.summary: A credential theft campaign targets advertising account managers using fake AI tool websites (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) to steal login credentials and MFA codes via browser-in-browser attacks. The attack method specifically bypasses multi-factor authentication by intercepting codes in real time through spoofed browser windows.

news.title: Welcome to the Jungle: What We Found Inside 15,465 Public MCP Servers
news.summary: OX Security researchers analyzed 15,465 public MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and found critical vulnerabilities in the ecosystem. The research identified security issues in how AI agents connect to tools and data, with implications for authentication and access control in agentic workflows.

news.title: Denmark Says Attackers Accessed CPR Data for 8.8 Million People via Company Account
news.summary: Attackers accessed Denmark's Central Person Register (CPR) through a compromised private company account, exposing names, addresses, and national identification numbers for 8.8 million people. The breach highlights risks associated with delegated access rights, where a company's legitimate authorization to query government records was exploited by unauthorized parties.

news.title: FusionAuth Establishes UK Team as European Demand for Data Sovereignty Drives 72% Regional Growth
news.summary: FusionAuth has established its first dedicated UK sales team amid 72% regional growth in Europe, driven by enterprise demand for data sovereignty and tenant isolation. The Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) vendor reported 48% new-business ARR growth in Q1, attributing expansion to organizations seeking greater data control.

news.title: The Credential Layer Is Expanding Faster Than Security Teams Can See It
news.summary: GitGuardian outlines its approach to securing the enterprise credential layer through detection, remediation, and prevention capabilities. The piece addresses the growing challenge of managing credentials across human, system, and AI identities in modern enterprises.

news.title: Apple Plans Tighter macOS Full Disk Access Controls Over AI Agent Data Access
news.summary: Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access (FDA) controls in response to security risks from AI agents accessing user data without full user awareness. The change targets developers who use FDA permissions to expose files, mail, messages, and browsing history beyond what users explicitly authorize.

news.title: Keeper Security Surpasses 100,000 Enterprise Customers as Organizations Consolidate Identity Security Solutions in the Agentic Era
news.summary: Keeper Security announced it has surpassed 100,000 enterprise customers for its zero-trust and zero-knowledge identity security platform. The milestone reflects broader enterprise consolidation of identity security solutions amid growing adoption of agentic AI environments.

news.title: tenfold CE: Our free Identity Governance tool just got 2 new features
news.summary: Tenfold has added shared content governance and real-time event auditing to its free Community Edition IGA tool for organizations with under 150 users. The new features support Microsoft 365 sharing management and identity activity investigation.

news.title: Keyfactor Appoints Former CyberArk CEO Matt Cohen to Board of Directors and Strategic Advisor
news.summary: Keyfactor has appointed Matt Cohen, former CyberArk CEO, to its board of directors and as a strategic advisor. The appointment coincides with Keyfactor closing a $1B+ growth investment led by Summit Partners as the company surpasses $200 million in ARR.

news.title: China-Aligned TA419 Targets U.S. AI Policy Experts With Microsoft AitM Phishing
news.summary: A China-aligned threat actor designated TA419 has conducted credential phishing campaigns targeting AI policy experts at U.S. think tanks, universities, and legal organizations. The attacks employ Microsoft Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) phishing techniques, impersonating economists, AI policymakers, and an Anthropic employee to steal credentials.

news.title: kl-security-key
news.summary: An experimental FIDO2/WebAuthn authenticator built on the RP2040 microcontroller has been developed with packed attestation support. The project includes documented interoperability testing with Windows and Microsoft Entra, making it relevant to hardware security key and passwordless authentication use cases.

news.title: What to expect at SailPoint’s Navigate event: Join theCUBE Oct. 6–7
news.summary: SailPoint's Navigate event is scheduled for October 6–7, featuring discussions on agentic AI and its impact on identity security. The event will cover how AI agents acquire permissions and interact with applications, expanding the scope of identity governance beyond traditional human and machine identities.

news.title: The IETF Published a Draft for Agent Identity. The Market Already Shipped.
news.summary: The IETF received a draft proposal (draft-embesozzi-oauth-agent-native-authorization-00) focused on agent identity and native authorization for AI agents using OAuth. The draft highlights the emerging standardization effort around non-human/agentic identity, an area where vendors have already begun shipping solutions ahead of formal specification.

news.title: Why Okta Tripled on … 11% Growth. 5 Interesting Learnings From One of the Biggest Re-Ratings in B2B This Year: 14% cRPO Growth, 30% of Bookings From New Products, and ~50x Forward Earnings
news.summary: The article analyzes Okta's significant stock re-rating in 2024, noting the company tripled in value despite modest 11% revenue growth. Key metrics highlighted include 14% cRPO growth and 30% of bookings coming from new products.

news.title: Kiteworks & Citrix Incidents Show Challenges of Zero-Day Response
news.summary: Kiteworks and Citrix both faced zero-day vulnerability incidents, with Kiteworks instructing customers to power down its data-protection platform during a nine-hour window while Citrix remained silent on reported attacks before releasing a patch. The incidents highlight contrasting vendor communication and response strategies when handling zero-day exploits affecting enterprise security platforms.

news.title: SWIFT Banking & Government Middleware Enables RCE
news.summary: Vulnerabilities in SWIFT banking and government middleware have been disclosed, enabling remote code execution (RCE). The flaws can be exploited to bypass hardware-based MFA in high-security environments, making patching urgent.

news.title: Dell CSM Flaws Enable Unauthenticated Admin Access and Root on Kubernetes Nodes
news.summary: Dell has released security updates addressing critical vulnerabilities in Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM), including CVE-2026-63688 (CVSS 10.0), which allows unauthenticated access to the csm-authorization-storage gRPC server. The flaws can be exploited to gain unauthorized admin access and root-level control on Kubernetes nodes.

news.title: Why CISOs Struggle to Answer the Board's Three Hardest Questions, and How to Fix the Report
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge CISOs face when reporting security posture to boards, with a focus on reconciling data from identity providers and other security tools. It frames the problem around answering high-level questions about organizational security using fragmented data sources including IAM systems.

news.title: Aembit Becomes First Third-Party Enforcement Point for Okta’s XAA Agent Identity Protocol
news.summary: Aembit has become the first third-party enforcement point for Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) protocol, an agent identity standard Okta formalized at Oktane in September 2026. XAA is an open protocol designed to standardize enterprise-managed identity for AI agents and cross-application access scenarios.

news.title: Dual NetScaler Zero-Days Trigger Chaos for Citrix Customers
news.summary: Two critical zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler products allow attackers to bypass authentication controls in default configurations. The flaws effectively grant unauthorized network access, functioning as authentication bypasses that compromise perimeter security for affected Citrix customers.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian national Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks also resulted in the theft of call and text records belonging to more than 100 million AT&T customers.
